items.title: neurocursor-ai

items.title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
items.title_cn: 用于长地平线Agent线束的递归体验式工作记忆进化
items.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) remains hard in long-horizon tasks, where growing histories obscure the task state and misalign skill invocation. We introduce Recuris, a recursive Experiential-Working Memory architecture for long-horizon agent harnesses, in which Working Memory tracks task progress...
items.summary_cn: 递归自我提升（ RSI ）在长期任务中仍然很难，在这些任务中，不断增长的历史记录掩盖了任务状态和技能调用不一致。我们引入了Recuris ，这是一种用于长时间代理线束的递归体验式工作记忆架构，其中工作记忆跟踪任务进度...
items.comment: 基准测试成绩亮眼，但测试集和实际场景是两码事，别被数字忽悠。

items.title: SPO++: Stream-Aligned Policy Optimization for Asynchronous Agentic RL
items.title_cn: SPO + + ：异步Agentic RL的流一致策略优化
items.summary: Group-relative reinforcement learning waits for sibling rollouts of the same prompt, which is costly for long and variable tool-use trajectories. Single-stream Policy Optimization (SPO) removes this dependency with a persistent prompt-level value estimate, but its recipe whitens one advantage per tr...
items.summary_cn: 组相关强化学习等待相同提示的兄弟推出，这对于长期和可变的工具使用轨迹来说是昂贵的。单流策略优化(SPO)通过持久的提示级值估计消除了这种依赖关系，但它的配方每次都会白化一个优势...
items.comment: 法规来了，短期阵痛难免，长期看是行业走向成熟的必经之路。

items.title: FedV-KGQA: Multi-Hop Question Answering over Vertically Partitioned Knowledge Graphs
items.title_cn: FedV-KGQA ：基于垂直分区知识图的多跳问题解答
items.summary: Real-world data for knowledge graph question answering is often distributed across different organizations due to governance and data sovereignty constraints. While centralized systems exist, they cannot answer multi-hop questions when the required facts are split across vertically partitioned silos...
items.summary_cn: 由于治理和数据主权的限制，知识图问答的现实世界数据通常分布在不同的组织中。虽然存在集中式系统，但当所需的事实分散在垂直分区的筒仓中时，它们无法回答多跳问题...

items.title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec, as stream of high-profile departures continues
items.title_cn: 随着高调离职潮的持续， OpenAI失去了一名顶级数据中心高管
items.summary: Before Malone left, OpenAI had already reshuffled its infrastructure org, shifting his reporting line away from President Greg Brockman and putting Vice President Sachin Katti in charge of the group.
items.summary_cn: 在马龙离开之前， OpenAI已经重组了其基础设施组织，将他的报告线从总裁格雷格·布罗克曼（ Greg Brockman ）转移到副总裁萨钦·卡蒂（ Sachin Katti ）负责该组织。
items.comment: 行业变化快，今天的热点明天可能就凉了，理性看待。

items.title: Instagram’s ‘First Draft’ feature aims to make editing Reels less tedious
items.title_cn: Instagram的“初稿”功能旨在减少编辑转轴的乏味性
items.summary: Instagram says the process can produce a first pass in under 10 seconds, potentially saving creators significant editing time while making video creation more approachable for people who don't have much experience with editing software.
items.summary_cn: Instagram表示，该流程可以在不到10秒的时间内生成第一个通行证，这可能会为创作者节省大量的编辑时间，同时使视频创作对于那些没有太多编辑软件经验的人来说更加平易近人。
items.comment: AI 领域新动态，保持关注，别被营销号带节奏。
